titleAr: تطبيق التغييرات اللي جهّزها المساعد وتأكيدها والرجوع فيها
titleEn: Apply, confirm or undo a change the assistant prepared
screens: AssistantPanel preview card (Apply, Undo) and confirm card

ar: ازاي أطبّق التغيير اللي المساعد جهّزه؟
en: How do I apply the change the assistant prepared?

steps: The assistant prepares a change and shows a preview card with the before and after; nothing has changed yet
Press Apply to make the change with your own permissions; press Undo within 24 hours to put it back
If the item changed since the preview, Apply shows a new preview instead of overwriting

A change that involves money, deletion, messages to your customers, more than 20 items or a price change shows a confirm card: only your press on its button makes it happen (typing yes does not); the card expires after 15 minutes
edgeCases: Mode below act: the card is shown but Apply is refused
Two presses on one card apply once
Your role does not allow the change: refused, nothing changes
Undo after you edited the item by hand: shows what undo would do, writes nothing
Two presses or two tabs on one confirm card apply once
Your role changed since the card was made: the press is refused and nothing changes
The item changed since the card was made: a new card with a new confirmation replaces it
